description: Lists the authenticated user's existing bookings, filtered by `type`: `UPCOMING` (default), `COMPLETED`, `CANCELLED`, or `PENDING`. Needs a registered LockTrip account session; guest sessions from `guest_login` cannot list bookings. Without a signed-in session, pass the user's `email` instead: LockTrip emails them a sign-in link to their bookings on locktrip.com, and the result has `magicLinkSent: true` (nothing is shown or changed in this chat). Returns `bookings[]` (each with `bookingId`, `bookingReferenceId`, `hotelName`, `checkIn`, `checkOut`, `status`, `roomCount`, `createdAt`, and `totalPrice` + `currency` when the booking records a price) plus `totalCount` (all matching bookings). Optional paging: `page` (0-based) and `size` (max 100); omit both for the full list. Pass a `bookingId` to `get_booking_details` or `cancel_booking`.

email.description: The user's LockTrip account email. Needed only when there is no signed-in session: LockTrip then emails that address a sign-in link to the user's bookings on locktrip.com (the bookings are not shown in this chat).

page.description: Page number, 0-based. Omit page and size for the full list.

name: list_bookings
title: List My Bookings
